cycle_cron.description: STEWARD_CYCLE_CRON -- six-field Quartz cron in UTC. Every six hours by default: a control loop that ticks faster than its measurement window can fill only measures noise.

description.purpose: The cycle tick. Six-field Quartz cron, UTC.
description.use_when: One per steward hive. Event triggers (a DLQ spike, a cost alert) are additional edges into ./meter, not a second timer.
description.not_in_scope: No judgement -- it emits a tick and nothing else.
